replay.command: cargo octet object corpus receipt --output RECEIPT.json src/lib.rs
replay.determinism_note: Receipt bytes are deterministic for the same selected source inputs and cargo-octet version; this is not a correctness proof.

boundary.detail: Function object corpus receipts summarize source-token object identity and caveats; they do not prove behavioral correctness, semantic equivalence, dependency resolution, macro expansion identity, or pure-cache eligibility.
